integrity: Two complete, inspectable, deterministic and standalone exhaustive enumeration implementations and their actual stdout records are included. The 2012-05-31 first_public_date is a verified public date for a graph source, not asserted to be the first-ever appearance of the Pappus graph.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite census only for the eighteen-vertex Pappus graph and closed-neighborhood identifying codes; token jumps only, not token slides. Finite independent implementations agree but no independent external validation or priority certification. Possible earlier unindexed tables remain a novelty risk.
title: A single extra sensor connects identifying codes of the Pappus graph
